notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Stitch Together from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
